name: meanrev-breadth-v1
description: PRE-REGISTERED 2026-09-24, BEFORE running. Hypothesis #2 from D-research-map.md section 6: increase financeable breadth of the live meanrev_stocks sleeve without touching the entry filter. Candidates {control 5x.10 (=0.5x nominal, the live config, identity of experiments/meanrev-control-pure-v1.json's single candidate), 7x.10 (0.7x), 10x.10 (1.0x)} — everything else FROZEN to the control: same Cutler RSI2 entry<5/SMA200/exit-SMA5/timeStop10, same hardStop volScaled {kSigma3,lookbackBars20,minPct2,maxPct12}, same 32-symbol universe, SPY refSymbol, 6x3 purged folds 2018-01-01..2026-08-06 (HON asOf cap), base/stress costs, minExcessSharpeVsBench gate. HYPOTHESIS (declared before running): more slots let the SAME RSI2<5/SMA200 filter capture more of the valid signals it already generates but currently turns away for lack of an open slot — meanrev-selectivity-v1 (artifact b7c8f176/ad634c7b diagnostic) showed the OPPOSITE direction (5->3 slots) monotonically destroys return (30.88->~13%) and Sharpe (0.570->~0.35) with no DD benefit, i.e. the marginal trades beyond the top-3-ranked-by-RSI are net POSITIVE expectancy on this filter; if that holds going the other way, adding slots should scale stitched return roughly with average exposure (0.5x -> 0.7x -> 1.0x) while Sharpe stays flat or improves (more names diversifies idiosyncratic single-name risk on any given day, since entries are independent RSI2 dips, not a single systematic bet). CASE AGAINST (declared before running, not to be argued away post-hoc if it happens): (1) signal quality is NOT uniform below the RSI2<5 cutoff — the marginal 6th-10th ranked candidate on a given day may already be lower-quality than the marginal 4th-5th that selectivity-v1 tested, since RSI2 is a coarse coincidence filter (2543 vs 2521 vs 2501 trades across entryRsi 5/3/2 in selectivity-v1 shows almost all RSI2 observations already clear <5 — MORE slots is a different axis than a TIGHTER threshold, and could behave differently); (2) correlation on crash days — Connors dips frequently coincide across the 32-name universe on broad selloffs (all 10 slots could fill on the SAME day, concentrating exactly the tail-risk day the sleeve is supposed to be diversifying into cash on other days), which would raise maxDD roughly proportionally to exposure rather than leaving it flat; (3) this shares the Alpaca wallet with momentum_stocks (now wired at 1.0x of its own $50k after 2026-09-23's gross cut) — a meanrev breadth increase above ~0.5x-0.6x is not free capital, it competes for the SAME Reg-T buying power the live 15s stop-loss loop and momentum_stocks entries also draw on; this manifest measures ONLY the isolated-sleeve backtest edge, NOT capital contention (scripts/walk-forward.ts evaluates one sleeve at a time — see D-research-map.md section 3, 'Reparto entre dos sleeves Alpaca'), so a positive result here is necessary but not sufficient for wiring. TRIAL ACCOUNTING: control(5x.10) is an execution identity of meanrev-control-pure-v1.json's single candidate, +0. 7x.10 and 10x.10 are new effective configs on the already-explored maxPositions axis (selectivity-v1 tested 3 and 5, never 7 or 10) — +2. priorUniqueTrials=25 (current meanrev running total per the ledger), this manifest contributes +2, bringing the total to 27 after execution.
